name: sprite

schema.description: Schema for image sprite generation files

customstyles.description: Define custom CSS declarations to inject into the generated stylesheet.

dpi.description: The image resolution of the generated image sprite

images.description: An array of file paths relative to this document. The name must be unique.

additionalProperties.description: A source image for the sprite.

optimize.description: Optimizes the generated image either lossy or lossless. Requires the "Image Optimizer" extension for Visual Studio

orientation.description: The orientation of the individual images inside the generated sprite.

output.description: Output format of the generated image sprite.

padding.description: The padding around each individual image in the sprite. The value is in pixels.

pathprefix.description: Add any path root in front of the generated. Example: "/images/"

stylesheet.description: Define stylesheets (css, less, sass) to be generated as part of the sprite generation process.

description:
Please generate a horizontal sprite in PNG format with a resolution of 144 dpi. The sprite should combine three icons— icon‑home (icons/home.png), icon‑settings (icons/settings.png) and icon‑user (icons/user.png) — arranged side‑by‑side with 8 pixels of padding between each image. Use lossless optimisation for the final output, and place the generated sprite under the path prefix “/images/sprites/”. A CSS stylesheet should be produced alongside the image.

In the accompanying stylesheet, inject the following custom declarations: set **background-size** to **contain**, apply a **margin** of **5 px**, and give the icons a **border‑radius** of **4 px**. This configuration should result in a ready‑to‑use CSS sprite sheet that references the generated PNG file.
